newsitem.title: ISRAEL: RESEARCH ALERT-UBS starts Nice with buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-UBS starts Nice with buy.

text.p: UBS has initiated coverage of Nice Systems with a buy rating, the company said in a report on Tuesday.

UBS said it estimated the company's earnings per share (EPS) to be $1.27 in 1997 and $1.72 in 1998. Its 12-month price target for Nice is $50, representing 30 times its 1998 EPS estimate, in line with comparable publicly traded companies.

"Over the next three years, we believe that Nice could generate 35 to 40 percent annual revenue and earnings growth (with higher growth forecast for 1997 and 1998) driven by the company's leading industry position, penetration of new rapidly growing end markets, superior technology and a strong new product pipeline," analyst Elan Zivotofsky said in the report.
Nice is a leading global provider of digital voice recording and retrieval systems.
"We believe that Nice is an excellent way to invest in this under-penetrated, $500 million world market which we estimate is growing at 20 percent per year," Zivotofsky said.
UBS said that Nice's new products should help the company penetrate important new markets, giving confidence to UBS' 45-50 percent revenue growth estimate over the next three years.
